title: knowledge.release_correlation_completed.v1
description: Integration-contract v1 for the ReleaseCorrelationCompleted event payload (EDR-DELIVERY-01 M2-1 / N-M2a): Knowledge has finished correlating ONE SBOM. Published once per SBOM and appended to the outbox AFTER every other Knowledge event raised for that SBOM, so a consumer handling it has already handled every earlier fact for that SBOM — the ordering is the transport's, not a timer's. An SBOM with no matched vulnerabilities still publishes it: silence must mean a fault, never 'nothing to report'. It states that correlation finished and deliberately NOT what the posture is — the counts belong to Governance, over Governance's own projection. Field names are snake_case (the convention M2-2 fixes for this pair of events, unlike the older Knowledge events which marshal Go field names), and the ids are carried verbatim as TEXT, never parsed.

sbom_id.description: The Evidence id of the SBOM that was correlated.

cause.description: Why correlation ran — a closed vocabulary (M2-3). `new_sbom` is an upload; `rediscovery` is the KN-RECOR-1 sweep, which is a real posture change but never starts or advances the rebuild loop. The producer knows the reason; a consumer inferring it from SBOM identity would be guessing, and a wrong guess silently spends an attempt budget.

occurred_at.description: Rides in the body as well as on the envelope: the consumer that stores these events keeps the body, and a stored fact that cannot say when it happened without its transport metadata is incomplete.
